serialize_proto_message: serialize a protobuf message to binary bytes with optional deterministic ordering
parse_proto_message: parse binary bytes into a protobuf message instance using the message class
serialize_length_prefixed_message: write a length-prefixed protobuf message to a buffered BytesIO output stream
parse_length_prefixed_message: parse a length-prefixed protobuf message from a buffered BytesIO input stream
clear_proto_field: clear the contents of a specific field or oneof group in a protobuf message
